source.description:
Handoff for session ending 2026-06-04.

**SSOT report:** `.xtrm/reports/2026-06-04-73046529.md`

Read the report first — it has the full summary, problems, open issues with context, and the ordered next-priority list. This bead is the live pointer into the board.

## PROBLEM

Two follow-ups from the xt spec v1 ship (xtrm-ai9xl) that weren't in-scope for the implementation epic but need to land before the feature is operator-ready:

1. **No live e2e smoke** — every test path runs against the *compiled* CLI but with mocked sp + bd binaries. We have no record of the actual operator workflow (real bd workspace + real sp planner dispatch on a real readiness-passing skill set) holding end-to-end.
2. **No user-facing docs** — `docs/specs/*.md` is the *reference* set (schema, JSON shape, gate criteria, upstream deps). `XTRM-GUIDE.md` carries one-line CLI rows. There is no `docs/xt-spec/` README, no quickstart, no lifecycle diagram, no troubleshooting page — anything a new operator would actually read.

## SUCCESS

1. A live smoke transcript exists demonstrating the full operator path: draft → edit → validate (clean) → doctor (current state today: 6 missing capabilities, exit 1) → apply --dry-run (clean XML) → apply --check-only (exit 65 with named missing capabilities) → confirm refusal is informative.
2. `docs/xt-spec/` exists with:
   - `README.md` — what xt spec is, when to use it (vs `/planning`), the lifecycle in one diagram.
   - `quickstart.md` — copy-paste path from `xt spec draft` through `xt spec archive`.
   - `lifecycle.md` — the transform-and-dispatch model, why the composition gate is the operator's call, why MVP2 is runtime-gated.
   - `troubleshooting.md` — common refusal codes (`spec_too_large`, `scrutiny_lower_than_inferred`, `readiness probe failed`, archive `review_missing` etc.) with fix hints.
3. CLAUDE.md updated to mention xt spec as part of "session start when handling a PRD" guidance (one paragraph).

## SCRUTINY: medium

## SCOPE

- Smoke: any throwaway dir + real bd workspace + xt CLI binary at `cli/dist/index.cjs`
- Docs: `docs/xt-spec/` (new dir), `CLAUDE.md` (existing)

## NON_GOALS

- Adding new CLI features
- Modifying the readiness probe matrix (that's owned upstream by specialists-roadmap)
- Writing API docs for the validator/checks internals (covered by SCHEMA.md already)

## CONSTRAINTS

- Smoke must NOT modify any deployed skill files to fake a passing readiness probe — the failure is the intended state today, and the smoke documents it.
- Docs must link `docs/specs/*.md` rather than duplicate them — those are the reference; `docs/xt-spec/` is the narrative layer.
- The lifecycle.md diagram should match the architecture commitment in `bd memories xt-spec-ships-v1` (transform-and-dispatch, not decomposer).
- Smoke transcript should be committed as `docs/xt-spec/smoke-transcript-2026-06-04.md` so the snapshot is auditable.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] `docs/xt-spec/README.md` exists with a one-paragraph "what + when" and a Mermaid (or ASCII) lifecycle diagram
- [ ] `docs/xt-spec/quickstart.md` exercises every subcommand on a throwaway spec
- [ ] `docs/xt-spec/lifecycle.md` explains the transform-and-dispatch + composition-gate model + MVP2 runtime gating
- [ ] `docs/xt-spec/troubleshooting.md` covers ≥6 named refusal codes with fixes
- [ ] `docs/xt-spec/smoke-transcript-2026-06-04.md` captures the live e2e path including exit codes + stderr log lines
- [ ] CLAUDE.md mentions xt spec in PRD intake guidance
- [ ] `XTRM-GUIDE.md` CLI rows updated to point at `docs/xt-spec/README.md`

## OUTPUT

A single commit with the docs/ tree + CLAUDE.md update + smoke transcript. PR optional (small enough for direct push).

## REFERENCES

- This session report: `.xtrm/reports/2026-06-04-73046529.md`
- Epic: xtrm-ai9xl (closed)
- Memory: `bd recall xt-spec-ships-v1-6-subcommands-draft-validate`
- Reference docs already in place: `docs/specs/{SCHEMA,VALIDATE-JSON,CHANGE-CONTRACT-SHAPE,ARCHIVE-GATE,UPSTREAM-DEPENDENCIES}.md`, `docs/specs/EXAMPLE.yaml`, `docs/migration/create-spec-deprecation.md`
